definitions.explanation: A plant used for its healing or therapeutic properties, either in traditional herbal medicine or modern pharmacology.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}で{薬草|やくそう}を{摘|つ}む。
examples.english: Pick medicinal herbs in the mountains.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{昔|むかし}から{薬草|やくそう}を{使|つか}った{民間|みんかん}{療法|りょうほう}が{伝|つた}わっている。
examples.english: In this region, folk remedies using medicinal herbs have been passed down since long ago.

examples.japanese: {薬草|やくそう}{園|えん}を{見学|けんがく}して、さまざまな{薬効|やっこう}のある{植物|しょくぶつ}について{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I visited a medicinal herb garden and learned about plants with various therapeutic properties.

notes:
USAGE:
Japan has a long tradition of herbal medicine ({漢方|かんぽう}), and {薬草|やくそう} appears frequently in discussions of traditional medicine, health foods, and natural remedies. Also a common term in video games and fantasy settings where herbs are used for healing.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {薬草|やくそう}{茶|ちゃ}: herbal tea (medicinal)
- {薬草|やくそう}{園|えん}: medicinal herb garden
- {薬草|やくそう}{風呂|ぶろ}: herbal bath

cross_references.label: grass, weeds, herbs (the general word for small plants)
